title: a16z Podcast: The Future of Money and Monetization

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: Technology companies are running hard at almost every part of the traditional banking business -- from raising funds to moving money from one person to another..
reader_summary.overview: Technology companies are running hard at almost every part of the traditional banking business -- from raising funds to moving money from one person to another. And as you would expect, that has meant change, both in terms of the banking services that are available to all of us. It begs the question of what role banks play going forward.
